summary: Master Defined Contribution Plans management. Learn plan design, fiduciary governance, and investment oversight to improve outcomes. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Defined contribution plan training helps benefits, finance, and plan administration professionals oversee retirement savings programs. It covers building fiduciary governance around an investment policy statement, assessing fund choices and fees, managing vendors, and shaping participant features such as automatic enrollment and escalation. Learners also practice preparing compliance risk assessments, communication roadmaps, and executive dashboards to support documented plan decisions.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals responsible for the strategic direction, compliance, and daily operation of retirement savings programs.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in human resources, finance, or benefits administration. A basic understanding of retirement plan terminology and financial markets is required. No programming knowledge is necessary, but proficiency in Excel for data analysis exercises is highly recommended.
